scope: Estimated isotropic Gaussian spatial regression, four kernels, optional independent record nugget and subject blocks; bounded partial spatial mixed-model support
integration_status: PASS matching macOS arm64 Release: focused public execute5tests; actual production public C ABI48calls/810numeric fields over16 independent ML/REML fits; DuckDBv2.0.0-alpha49307 actual SQL16fits/130numeric fields,3saved-model roundtrips,15malformed NULL cases and selected/join/interleaved NULL vectors.

common_contract.input: Finite rectangular rows with absolute data values<=1e100; missing/NULL rejected. Coordinates have caller-supplied consistent units. Subject labels are exact integers with abs<=2^53-1; equal labels define independent covariance blocks. All-zero labels give one block.
common_contract.kernels: 0 spherical r(h)=(1-u)^2(1+u/2) for u=h/length<1 else0; 1 exponential exp(-h/length); 2 Gaussian exp(-(h/length)^2); 3 JMP Power rho^h using rho=exp(-1/length). kind3 and kind1 describe the same isotropic family under different parameterization. The fitted length/range_parameter always has coordinate-distance units. kernel_parameter gives JMP rho for Power, length otherwise; physical Power rho can round to0 or1 at extreme length and is descriptive only, the carrier retains length.
common_contract.variance: V=total_variance*((1-w)*R_block+w*I). partial_sill=(1-w)*total_variance; nugget=w*total_variance; total_sill=total_variance. Off-block process covariance0. Independent record nugget only on covariance diagonal even for collocated observations. JMP report nugget/residual ratio is not silently treated as physical nugget variance.
common_contract.model: Always an intercept plus p explicitly supplied numeric full-rank fixed features. Twice-reorthogonalized QR profiles fixed effects. Positive total variance is estimated as GLS residual SSE/n for ML or SSE/(n-p-1) for REML. Gaussian log likelihood includes determinant and normalizing constants; REML includes logdet(X'V^-1X) in physical feature units. Exact zero/roundoff-level residual variance rejects rather than inventing a positive floor.
common_contract.optimization: Deterministic coarse grid plus up to6 bounded Nelder-Mead starts and3 explicit zero-nugget-face starts. Shape parameters are log correlation length and optional nugget fraction in[0,1]. Each start has maxiter; at most3e9 charged dense n^3 work units across all objective calls, with100 likelihood-evaluation reserve for final/information computations. Budget exhaustion rejects rather than returning truncated-search results. Simplex convergence is independently checked by projected finite-difference first-order score in unit search coordinates, scaled by1+abs(normalized profile nll), threshold1e-4. No global optimum certificate. likelihood_evaluations reports charged search/score closure calls; the separate final/profile-information reserve is excluded from this diagnostic counter.
common_contract.range_bounds: Either both optional positive length bounds or neither. Defaults min_positive_within_subject_distance*0.001 and max_within_subject_distance*1000. If no positive within-subject distance exists, defaults0.001/1000. Require1e-100<=lower<upper<=1e100. Contact within1e-6 of a unit-coordinate bound disables combined convergence and covariance inference. User must inspect bound diagnostics and widen bounds when needed.
common_contract.inference: Interior full observed negative-likelihood Hessian central differences step2e-4 on [log(total_variance),log(length),optional identity nugget_fraction], profiling fixed effects but not re-profiling scale. Positive-definite factorization required. Delta-method maps inverse information to physical [partial_sill,nugget,length] or [partial_sill,length]. Standard errors and untruncated normal Wald95% intervals are supplied only when locally identified and away from active bounds. Nonconverged search, boundary, or failed information returns null covariance/SE/CI. This is explicitly not JMP bounded Satterthwaite inference and does not support unbounded negative variance components.
common_contract.prediction_carrier: Version1 flat array [1,dimensions,fixed_features,n,kind,partial_sill,nugget,correlation_length,original_training_rows_flat...]. At most1256 values for d3,p8,n96, safely below public ABI16384. Rebuilds normalized covariance and trend at fixed fitted physical covariance, without optimizing/refitting covariance parameters. Original training data and row/subject order are preserved.
common_contract.prediction: Plug-in universal kriging with fixed-effect estimation correction given fitted covariance. Query nugget is independent even at a training coordinate/subject. latent variance omits new query nugget; observation variance adds it. Matching training records with zero nugget return structural zero variance. Unseen subject process cross-covariance is0 and prediction reduces to fixed trend, with residual/process and fixed-effect uncertainty. Covariance parameter estimation uncertainty is excluded and explicitly labeled.
common_contract.resource: fit n<=96,p<=8,d1..3; predict query<=1000. Finite rectangular inputs, args<=16384. Dense likelihood cost is cubic in n; exhaustion fails closed.
